name: HighLevel
summary: CRM, funnel, texting, email and automation platform for agencies, with white-label options and a 14-day free trial.
best_for: marketing agencies and consultants who manage several clients and want CRM, funnels, texting, email and automation in one white-label platform
skip_if: you need a simple CRM for one small team, a flat price with no metered usage, or you do not want to spend time configuring a large platform
honest_knock: The headline plan price is only part of the bill: calls, SMS, email and AI features are usage-based and the add-ons are charged per sub-account. Billing starts automatically when the free trial ends, and the pricing page changes its plan names and annual figures between pages, so confirm the plan and amount at checkout.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · Starter billed monthly, for one business or a few clients (3 sub-accounts per the FAQ)
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-07 on gohighlevel.com/pricing) HighLevel sells its agency CRM and marketing-automation platform in three published plans plus a custom Enterprise plan. Starter costs $97 a month ($970 a year) and is meant for one business or a few clients; the FAQ says it includes 3 sub-accounts. Unlimited costs $297 a month, for agencies managing unlimited clients, and adds a white-label desktop app, basic API access and pass-through billing for usage and add-ons. Founder costs $497 a month and adds SaaS mode with unlimited reselling, project management, meeting rooms and events. Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial and billing begins automatically at the end of the trial unless you cancel. The page shows annual prices next to the monthly ones, but the annual amounts on the Unlimited and Founder cards do not match their monthly plans in the page text we read, so we do not quote them. Usage-based charges apply to conversation AI, voice AI, reviews AI, email and SMS marketing and calling, and optional add-ons are billed on top, for example the AI Employee plans at $50 or $97 a month per sub-account, the branded client portal app at $49 a month per sub-account and HIPAA compliance at $297 a month. The FAQ says billing is month to month with no long-term contract.

Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-11-07.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested HighLevel in the 14-day Starter trial that we started with our card. Adding contacts and a draft workflow worked in a few minutes. Billing matched the dossier: $97 a month, charged automatically when the trial ends on 3 December. Cancelling worked in the app the same day but took about nine screens, five retention offers and the account password. Account and start: we created the account and started the 14-day Starter trial with his own card; a phone number was required at sign-up and we entered it ourselves. Our AI assistant ran the test in our browser, in its own tab, on 19 November 2026, after switching the language from Dutch to English (US). The app opened on an Ask AI onboarding assistant, which was not answered. The agency billing view first said it was still loading and opened after about 30 seconds. No SMS code or phone check was seen in the session. Core action, contacts and a workflow: the CRM already held 5 example contacts. Two test contacts with example addresses were added with the plus button in about 2 minutes (Contact has been created); no e-mail or SMS channel was ticked and nothing was sent. A workflow from scratch with the trigger Contact created and the action Add contact tag (new tag new-lead) took about 3 minutes; it first warned that fields were missing until the tag was set, and it was saved as a Draft, not published. The inbox and calendar were opened; nothing was booked. The funnel and website builder were not opened. Plans: Billing showed Starter plan, Trial Plan, $97 per month, Skip Trial & Pay (not clicked) and Your trial will end in 13 days. After system will automatically charge your card. The trial ends on 3 December 2026; the exact charge time is not shown. Agency add-ons list HIPAA Compliance $297 per month; Compare plans and Upgrade were not opened. Checkout: the trial checkout was done by us before the session and was not seen. Cancelling, done the same day: Settings, Billing, Modify subscription, Show more, Cancel Plan. The flow showed a reason screen (we chose I'm just exploring and not ready to commit yet), then three offers (a personal tour, a 5-day lead sprint, 15% off the first 3 invoices), all declined; a data-loss warning that the contacts, workflows, funnels and conversation history go and that the $2.00 wallet credit is forfeited; a pause offer at $27/month with the first month free (declined); a required feedback box; a 50% off first invoice offer (declined); and Confirm cancellation, which asks for the account password. We typed the password himself. Billing then read ES101 - No active subscription with agency plan for customer. That is about nine screens and five retention offers, with no call to support. Whether the trial features stay open until 3 December was not checked. Not tested: the funnel and website builder, sub-accounts, phone numbers, sending e-mail or SMS, campaigns, A2P registration, domains, snapshots, white label, reporting and real usage costs. Clean up: the account, the two test contacts and the workflow draft stay. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: A phone number is required at sign-up. The workflow editor warns about missing fields until the action is complete. Cancelling takes about nine screens with five retention offers and asks for the account password, and the $2.00 wallet credit is forfeited.
